EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Looks like it's {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Shamrock Day{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0024:}}You know, that really important
holiday we celebrate every year
about...that one...important thing...
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}I'll be honest, I kinda don't have a
clue what today's about.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000B:}}I know there's something about
green... Maybe shamrocks... {{TAG:0003:0029:}}But
that's pretty much it!

FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Aujourd'hui, c'est le jour du trèfle !
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Tu sais, ce jour où on célèbre le...
enfin... euh...{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Tu connais ?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Moi, je suis pas sûr de
savoir exactement de quoi il s'agit.
Un truc en rapport avec le vert.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Bon,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} en tout cas j'espère que tu vas

IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Toh, oggi è il {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Giorno del trifoglio{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Hai presente? Quella festa che
ricorre solo una volta all'anno,

{{TAG:0003:001B:}}A dir la verità, non ho la più pallida
idea di cosa stiamo festeggiando!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Mi pare che abbia a che fare
con qualcosa di verde... {{TAG:0003:0029:}}I trifogli,
forse?
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Beh, mentre ci penso, tu divertiti!

{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Heute ist {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Kleeblatttag{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Und deshalb
wünsche ich dir...{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Was auch immer man sich an diesem

Feiertag wünscht,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.

{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Görünüşe göre bugün {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Yonca Günü{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0024:}}

şey var ya...
şu... önemli olan...

{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Ama kutlamamak için bahane değil!
